commit_message: Compute BTC benchmark alpha in replication reports
pr_body:
Closes #119

Computes a price-only BTC buy-and-hold benchmark from replication OHLCV artefacts, reports benchmark PnL and replication alpha, and preserves an explicit distinction from the paper's funding-adjusted benchmark.
